title: Fizzl Buy: install the wallet in Claude once, then your agent buys what it needs on its own (~75 seconds)

card.title: Your agent needs data it doesn't have.
card.sub: Tomorrow's weather. A price. A search.

segments.text: Your AI agent needs something it doesn't have. Tomorrow's weather, a price, a search result.
First, once: install the Fizzl Agent Wallet in Claude. Download it from wallet.fizzl.eu and open the file. No keys, no config file. On Claude Code or Cursor, it's one line.
Put a dollar or two in your agent's wallet, and set how much it may spend on its own, per purchase and per day.
Then just ask. Here, Claude is asked to buy tomorrow's forecast for Amsterdam via buy.fizzl.eu. It pays $0.02 from its own wallet, within that limit. No click needed.

Behind that one call, Fizzl Buy does the work. It picks a weather API that x402 Doctor saw paying out on 29 of the last 30 days, fills in the request, checks the seller before paying, pays it $0.001, and checks the answer.
Fourteen seconds later, the forecast is back, with the service it came from and a signed receipt. When no seller delivers, nothing is charged.
That's all it takes: install the wallet in Claude, set a limit, and ask.
